text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The resignation by opposition Alliance for Democracy (AFORD) candidate to contest in the postponed Blantyre by-election is the ruling United Democratic Front party's ploy to frustrate the opposition, an AFORD MP said.
- The ruling United Democratic Front party plots to arrest former president Kamuzu Banda and his close associate John Tembo on charges of a financial nature, a source says.
- The Ugandan drug, Miriandina, invented by Professor Ssali, claimed to be an Aids cure this week hit Blantyre and sold like hot cakes entirely wiping out available stocks.
- Seven dead bodies were last week exhumed with some organs like eyes, genitals and umbilical cords missing and their coffins strewn around the graves in Kasungu district of central Malawi.
